changelog:
- Initial release of the trading-signal skill for monitoring on-chain Smart Money signals.
- Retrieve real-time buy/sell signals, trigger price, current price, max gain, and exit rate.
- Supports filtering by chain (BSC and Solana) and paginated results.
- Provides detailed token tags, launch platform, and social/sensitive events for each signal.
- Includes full API documentation and example requests for easy integration.
